h2: Handyman Kerobokan & Umalas – Small Repairs, One Visit
intro: Living full-time in a villa around Kerobokan Kelod or Umalas means doors stick after the wet season, mosquito screens sag, and bathroom seals soften within months. A handyman service covering Kerobokan & Umalas bundles all those small fixes into one visit. No more chasing separate tradespeople for every little thing on your to-do list.

sections.h3: Why Humidity and Mixed-Age Villas Create Constant Small Repairs
sections.text: In Kerobokan Kaja and Batu Belig, older villas sit right next to new builds, so you'll see both corroded old-pipe fittings and fresh drywall that needs a shelf bracket. Tropical humidity swells timber door frames, warps hinge plates, and turns rigid silicone into crumbly residue. Mosquito screens stretch as the mesh loses tension over time. These aren't dramatic failures — they're the slow, steady wear long-term families notice first. One visit can reset hinges, re-silicone the shower tray, and tighten a curtain rail before things get worse.

sections.h3: What We Typically Fix in Umalas and Kerobokan Kelod
sections.text: A common call from a family villa in Umalas looks like this: two bedroom doors need hinge adjustment after the last rain, the basin seal has gone black, and a floating shelf is bowing under books. In Kerobokan Kelod, bigger gardens mean irrigation lines leak near the fence line and drainage channels back up when the rice-field water table rises. We handle locks, TV wall-mounts, furniture assembly, and mosquito screen replacement alongside those plumbing-adjacent bits. Send photos of each item and we'll confirm what fits one trip.

sections.h3: How to Request a Quote on WhatsApp
sections.text: Snap a few clear photos — the sticking door at both top and bottom, the mouldy silicone strip, the wobbly bracket — and send them with a short note on which room it's in. Mention your area (Umalas, Banjar Anyar, Batu Belig) so we can plan the route efficiently. If you have three or four small items, list them all in one message; pricing depends on the specific job, and we'll reply with a quote once we've reviewed the pictures. Everything stays right there in your chat thread.

sections.h3: Prevention Tips for Long-Term Villas in This Area
sections.text: Because groundwater stays high here, similar to Canggu, septic tanks and floor drains deserve a check after every heavy-rain week. For doors, a quick hinge tightening twice a year stops frames from warping permanently. Re-silicone bathroom joints before black mould sets in — it takes ten minutes versus an hour of scraping later. Keep mosquito screens clean and check mesh tension each dry season. In older Kerobokan villas sharing walls with newer builds, watch for hairline cracks near pipe penetrations early rather than waiting for a drip under the sink.

faq.q: Do you cover both Kerobokan and Umalas in a single visit?
faq.a: Yes — if your villa sits anywhere between Kerobokan Kelod, Batu Belig, and Umalas, multiple small fixes can be bundled into one trip. Just list everything when you send photos on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I combine a lock change with re-siliconing and a shelf fix?
faq.a: Absolutely. That's exactly what this service is built for — several unrelated small jobs handled in one sitting so you're not booking separate visits for each item.

faq.q: What should I include in my WhatsApp message for a fair quote?
faq.a: Clear photos of each item from two angles, the room it's in, and your neighbourhood (Umalas, Banjar Anyar, etc.). We'll come back with pricing based on what we see.
